name: get_capabilities
description: Call this first. Returns what the video model accepts (aspects, length limits, reference and keyframe limits, quality modes), the prompt tag syntax (<Picture N>, <Video N>, <Audio N>), render-time estimates, guardrail settings, and whether a GPU worker is up right now.

name: create_upload
description: Get a presigned HTTPS PUT URL for one input file (reference image, keyframe, reference video, reference audio, or soundtrack). Upload the bytes with: curl -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: <content_type>' --upload-file <file> '<upload_url>'. Then pass the returned key to generate_video. URLs expire after 15 minutes; uploaded inputs are deleted after the stack's input retention period.

filename.description: Original file name, used for the extension (e.g. singer.png, song.wav, move.mp4).

content_type.description: MIME type sent with the PUT, e.g. image/png, image/jpeg, audio/wav, audio/mpeg, video/mp4.

name: generate_video
description: Queue one video generation and return a job_id immediately (renders take minutes; get_capabilities has estimates). Poll get_job until status is SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED or CANCELLED. With backend h3 the model makes picture and sound in one pass: put any sung or spoken line in the prompt in quotes, whole. Reference media are tagged in the prompt in upload order: refs -> <Picture 1..n>, then first_frame/keyframes/last_frame continue the <Picture> numbering; ref_videos -> <Video n>; ref_audios -> <Audio n>. On h3 a soundtrack makes the character lip-sync to real audio; on wan2.2 it is muxed onto the silent render.

backend.description: Model backend: wan2.2 (default, Apache-2.0, silent 720p video, text or first-frame to video) or h3 (MiniMax-H3: picture + sound in one pass, references, keyframes, lip-sync; only if the operator enabled it). get_capabilities lists what is enabled.

prompt.description: Scene, action, camera and energy in 1-3 sentences. Quote every line that is sung or spoken. Max 4000 characters.

seconds.description: Clip length, 5-15 (the trained range). Default 5, or the soundtrack length when one is given. Snapped to the model's frame cadence.

quality.description: full (default, 20 steps, best lip-sync and detail), draft8 or draft4 (turbo LoRA, 2-4x faster, weaker on wide shots).

model.description: singularity (default, the Singularity v1.3 community fine-tune) or ref2va (stock MiniMax-H3 ref2va).

seed.description: Fix for a repeatable take. Random if omitted.

refs.description: Up to 9 reference images (identity, costume, location). Not pinned to a time. (h3 only)

ref_videos.description: Up to 3 reference videos (motion or camera move, 2-15 s). Their soundtrack rides along. Note: the model copies the subject of a ref video, not only its motion. (h3 only)

ref_audios.description: Up to 3 reference audio clips (a voice or music to match). (h3 only)

first_frame.description: Upload key of the image pinned as frame 0. A real photoreal start frame is the biggest quality lever.

last_frame.description: Upload key of the image pinned as the final frame.

keyframes.description: Images pinned at a time. Keep camera moves to about 3 pins per 7 s, and make the pins agree on the world, or the model hard-cuts between them. (h3 only)

at.description: Seconds from the start; negative counts from the end.

soundtrack.description: Audio anchored onto the output; on-camera singing or speech lip-syncs to it.

from.description: Trim start in the source file, seconds.

at.description: Where it starts in the output, seconds. Default 0.

keep_original.description: Replace the model's decoded audio with the original file in the final mp4 (use for songs and VO). Default true.

idempotency_key.description: Any string; retries with the same key return the same job instead of queueing a duplicate.

labels.description: Free-form string labels stored on the job (project, cost center, shot id).

negative_prompt.description: What to avoid (wan2.2). A sensible default is applied.

name: get_job
description: Status of one job: QUEUED, STARTING, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED (failed a content check) or CANCELLED, plus phase, timings, and on success presigned URLs for the mp4, a poster frame and the provenance manifest (valid for 1 hour by default; call again for fresh URLs).

name: list_jobs
description: Your recent jobs, newest first, with status and prompt preview.

status.description: Optional filter: QUEUED, RUNNING, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED or CANCELLED.

name: cancel_job
description: Cancel a queued or running job. A running render is interrupted on the GPU.

name: gpu_capacity
description: See or steer the GPU fleet. status = instances, spot or on-demand, boot phase, queue depth. warm = start one worker now so the next job skips the ~5 min cold start. release = scale to zero when nothing is running. use_on_demand / use_spot = switch the purchase option when spot capacity is short.
